rationale: Read all22 original declarations, four embedded command variants, fixture producers and stdin iteration against real request builders and handlers. These cases observe independently expected public RPCs/errors/output rather than private shapes; no test source edits warranted.

cases.title: maps --full issue reads to read-only issueContext RPC
cases.reason: Full issue request sets every include flag, default depth and local cwd context while using independently expected120-second read budget.

cases.title: maps MCP-compatible list-issues filters and cursor pagination
cases.reason: Actual list-issues dispatch forwards team,assignee,numeric priority,cursor,order and archived flag through independently expected RPC filter fields.

cases.title: prints truncation on human stdout and in JSON without using stderr for JSON
cases.reason: Human and JSON invocations independently verify truncation on stdout; human continuation warning appears on stderr while JSON suppresses it.

cases.title: rejects --depth unless children are requested
cases.reason: Depth without requested children rejects before RPC with explanatory error and failing status.
